2. Facts leading to the issuance of the Rule are inter alma that the opposite party being plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 67 of 1988 before the Court of the learned Sub-ordinate Judge presently Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka which was renumbered as Title Suit No. 412 of 1990 impleading the opposite parties as defendants for declaration of title in the suit land as mentioned in the schedule to the plaint contending inter alia, that the land measuring 1.58 acres in the plot Nos. 1859, 1782 and 1864 of CS Khatian No. 505 corresponding to SA Khatian No. 742 of Mouza Nandipara, Police Station-Demra (previous Tejgaon) Dhaka belonged to one Guru Dayal Mondol as the owner having recorded his name in CS Khatian and he was in possession of the suit land until his death. Guru Dayal Mondol died leaving behind his son, Surendra Mondol as his only heir to inherit his estate. Surendra Mondol inherited total 2.20 acres of land after mutual partition among his ancestors. Surendra Mondol died leaving behind his widow Makhani Bewa and also a minor daughter Robi Soria and a minor son Ratan Mondol alias Ratan. Under the Hindu Succession Law Makhani Bewa and Robi Sona were not entitled to inherit the properties as legal heirs but they had rights for enjoyment of the suit property. 

 7. While the aforesaid Guru Doyal Mondol was an absolute owner of the suit land and he died leaving behind Surendra Mondol as his only heir. Surendra Mondol by mutual partition with his co-sharers got the suit land in previous Mouza No. 317 corresponding to present Mouza No. 123 at Nandipara, previous Khatian No. 505 present Khatian No. 2196, previous dag No. 1859 corresponding to present dag No. 3946 measuring 47 decimals of land, previous dag No. 1864 corresponding to the present dag No. 400 measuring 44 decimals of land; previous dag No 1782 corresponding to the present dag No. 3936 and 3932 measuring 67 decimals of land and other properties. While Surendra Mondol was an absolute owner and was in possession, he left this transitory world leaving behind his widow Makhani Bewa and his minor daughter, Robi Sona and a minor son, Ratan Mondol alias Ratan and after the death of Surendra Mondol, his widow Makhani Bewa's family was thrown into a serious financial difficulty. Therefore, being in urgent Legal necessity, Makhani Bewa for herself and on behalf of her minor children sold the suit land to Hasina Warda Chowdhury by the sale deed executed and registered or' 6-2-1970 and 26-2- 1970. Makhani had no other option but to sell the suit land because she urgently needed to repay the loans availed by her deceased husband Surendra Mondol and to incur their maintenance, in order to save the children from starvation and to have a home to live in along with the minor children. Thereafter, Makhani Bewa left Bangladesh, the then East Pakistan, for India for ever to live there along with her minor children Ratan Mondol and Robi Sona. Makhani, Ratan and Robi Sona never came back to Bangladesh and their names never appeared in the voter-list of Bangladesh as they neither lived in Bangladesh nor they were the citizens of Bangladesh. They are the Citizens of India. Ratan had no title and possession in the suit land, therefore, the impugned deed is illegal, rnalafide and fabricated. 

 9. Having purchased the suit land, the petitioner Nos. 1 to 8 and 3 other purchasers became the absolute owners of the suit land and they are in uninterrupted and continuous possession of the suit land since 1987 by mutating and recording their respective names in the Tahshil Office and in RS Khatian respectively. The petitioners are regularly paying rents, taxes to the Government and municipality. Therefore, the opposite party's claim of the purchase of the suit land from or exchange of the suit land with Ratan Mondol is completely false, malafide, fabricated and therefore, the same deed has got no value in the eye of law and the transaction made on 9-3- 1987 by the opposite party is only a paper transaction created by fictitious person in the name of Ratan Mondol of in order to defraud the legal system of the country.
